propositions: Every supported Cloud/DC mutation route must have exactly one typed coordinator/adapter owner with no generic fallbacks or duplicate retry paths.
Unsupported production actions must return a typed provider-neutral error before any local or remote write effect occurs.
Production dispatch must use explicit declared protocol (@runtime_checkable) attributes rather than class-name strings or duck typing, preventing cross-loaded class identity issues.
Generic whole-operation retry and _best_effort write swallowing must be unreachable from production code paths.
Tests must use explicit declared protocol fakes rather than production fallback paths.
Rollback must rely on code/routing reversion and remote re-observation, never compensate by deleting successful remote mutations.
